method: Fresh processes, alternating arm order by shape; 10 measured samples per process using hrxdb-bench warmups. Compilation and ingestion excluded. No concurrent qualification workloads. This is a regression check, not a general speedup claim.

cases.timing: Host wall time with explicit completion; three warmups; serialized changing queries; scratch reserved before timing; scan/control exclude query preparation; search includes normalization, query publication, optional exclusion bitmap preparation and masking, selection and readback. GB/s uses unpadded FP16 vector bytes and decimal GB.

Host completion. Three warmups, changing queries, alternating sequential/batch timing order. Compilation and workspace reservation excluded; query preparation, selection, masking and readback included. No concurrent hrxdb benchmark or GPU tests.

reproduction: Build hrxdb-bench --locked --release from source_commit for 0.8.7; update the HRX dependency and lockfile to 0.8.11 and rebuild for the candidate. Execute the per-case arguments using each binary in separate processes with HRX runtime/compiler overrides unset. Output paths are omitted below.
